technology_name: METHOD FOR FABRICATING A HIGH-PERFORMANCE COMPOSITE DESALINATION MEMBRANE WITH ENHANCED WATER FLUX AND SALT REJECTION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional desalinating membranes exhibit low chemical durability and endure trade-offs between water volumetric flux rates and absolute salt rejection metrics.
description: Fabrication of a composite multi-walled carbon nanotube-nanographene membrane engineered to optimize internal water channel placement, supplying high permeation flux alongside elevated salt rejection tolerances.
applications: Industrial seawater reverse osmosis facilities, clean drinking water supply infrastructure, wastewater filtration setups, and portable military survival filters.
